import openpyxl, os
out=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws=wb['Sheet3']
# build code->month map from D3:E14
m={}
for r in range(3,15):
    c=ws.cell(r,4).value
    v=ws.cell(r,5).value
    if c is not None:
        m[str(c).strip()]=v
for r in range(3,15):
    a=ws.cell(r,1).value
    if a is None:
        continue
    parts=str(a).split('_')
    code=parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ''
    ws.cell(r,2).value=m.get(code.strip())
wb.save(out)
print('done')
